research.searchCoverage: Official Botpress Cloud Admin API (https://api.botpress.cloud/v1/admin, Bearer token, required x-workspace-id, GET /bots, GET /bots/{id}, GET /workspaces), Montreal Quebec operator, and dated incident search (Botpress + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. GitHub issue 14988 about transitive axios/valibot advisories in @botpress/webchat is a dependency advisory, not a confirmed Botpress Cloud compromise. No qualifying current unresolved Cloud Admin API incident was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Botpress Cloud Admin API v1
research.searchCoverage: Official Botpress Cloud Admin API uses a fixed host api.botpress.cloud and a required stored workspace ID in the x-workspace-id header, not a caller-supplied host. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found no qualifying unresolved Botpress Cloud compromise. GitHub #14988 is a webchat transitive-dependency advisory, not a Cloud Admin API breach.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /bots with stored x-workspace-id, matching the pinned validator.
Required stored workspaceId interpolates the x-workspace-id header on fixed host api.botpress.cloud (header id, not a caller host).
Native category is dev-tools (source AI/Developer Tools; AI is not in Rust CATEGORIES).
The upstream user-agent is not sent. Writes are omitted.
Optional nextToken and handle bind to official query names on GET /workspaces. Tags object encoding is omitted.
Returns raw Botpress JSON under data.
Optional dev, nextToken, sortField, and sortDirection bind to official query names. Dynamic tags[key] query encoding is omitted.
Returns raw {bots, meta} JSON under data.
